name: EMUN investiční společnost
decision_note: Licensed investment company acting as a multi-family-office platform (wealth and portfolio management, trust administration, investment funds) for clients' assets - a service provider; no direct private-company investing found.

evidence.quote: EMUN investiční společnost, a.s. je česká multi-family office platforma pro významné rodinné a institucionální investory.
Nabízí služby v oblasti plánování nástupnictví, správy majetku, diskrečního portfolio managementu a investičních fondů.

analyst_notes: Self-described family office (emun.cz) managing private portfolios of individuals, families and foundations, diversified across capital markets and alternatives; first ČNB-licensed institutional trustee; manages over CZK 16bn (site) / over CZK 10bn at 2024-12-31 (CVCA profile). It manages clients' wealth for fees rather than investing its own capital directly in private companies, so it is excluded as a service provider (E1). If evidence of direct private-company investments is found, it could instead be typed family_office (S1).
